Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the product looked promising. Our security and engineering teams want to schedule a formal compliance walkthrough (SOC 2 scoping, DPA review, and a short pen-test intake plan). We have two constraints: 1) we need coverage for both US and EU regions, and 2) vendor pen-test vendor (ThirdPartySec) would like a 30-minute technical intake ahead of the main walkthrough.

Can you propose 2–3 60–90 minute windows next week that cover:
- SOC 2 controls overview (30–40 min)
- DPA/data residency discussion (15–20 min)
- Pen-test intake and next steps (15–30 min)

Attaching our intake form and a preliminary list of controls. We prefer mornings PST but can accommodate afternoons CET if needed.
